selection_basis: Rank original Qv11 RACEtest16 actual fullmodel native allQ4-minus-single-N8 mean correct answer next-token fullvocab NLL, retain best single for three different roles. This uses previous Qv11 development evaluation and MUST be considered prior-data-driven, not independent source-only.
precision_contract: Q4 arm exactly 0 n8 +196 Q4; singleton exactly 1 n8 +195 Q4; pair exactly 2 n8 +194 Q4; all other original model code, quantization kernels and BF16 source weights unchanged.
C_native_build_contract: Original SHA-audited Qv5 mixed C research source copied twice: cardinality assert total_n8!=28 -> !=1 or !=2; no other semantic modifications, allow log messages only; original Q4 base C executable unchanged. Compare masks/roles/logs SHA in independent audit.
held_selection: Official revision original RACE middle test, choose next 16 DISTINCT valid complete untruncated articles by SHA256(rev+'/test/'+article_id+'/'+question), explicitly excluding every article ID in prior Qv11 sealed RACEtest16. Use same original Qwen ChatML <=208 tokens, four distinct single-token A/B/C/D completion labels.
held_not_pristine_model_pretraining: Public RACEtest16 is newly selected relative to Qv11 but could have been seen in base-model pretraining; 16 examples exploratory, not globally untouched validation.
per_question_loss: Original actual BEGLIN native full vocabulary normalized correct answer letter teacher forced NLL; accuracy argmax among A/B/C/D.
interaction_definition: For each pair i,j and each article s, I_ij(s)=NLL_Q4+i+j(s)-NLL_Q4+i(s)-NLL_Q4+j(s)+NLL_Q4(s). Mean I<0 indicates superadditive NLL gain (negative interaction); I>0 indicates subadditive NLL gain. Compare only within same exact article/token data.
interaction_subtlety: This finite difference isolates joint effect of quantization decisions relative to full Q4, not pure Hessian or inherent causal importance of trained model weights; the 1/2-n8 C binaries have different mask-cardinality guard but identical original NEON kernels and model arithmetic.
expected_additive_pair_gain: Predicted combined NLL improvement G_i+G_j using single N8 gains G_i=NLL_Q4-NLL_i measured prospectively on new held cohort, not previous Qv11 development means. Test pair actual G_ij and interaction residual.
statistics: Bootstrap 5000 paired-by-article resamples, fixed seed 20261023 for pair I_ij means and singleton recovery. Optionally exact paired sign test; all 3 pair comparisons are exploratory and no multiple test correction.
source_to_eval_leakage_policy: Previous RACE16 source-selected pairs, evaluation new disjoint RACE test16 with prior article IDs excluded; do not refit or reselect pairs from new test outputs.
constraints: Total 2-n8 in pair is not budget-matched to official 28-n8 mixed policy; role shapes yield differing incremental memory and latency. Do not claim improved 28-of-196 allocator or final throughput.
privacy: Original BF16 model weights, raw source C library binaries, per-question native logs and tokens under lab_local only; public commit has prelock, separate CPU intervention code, aggregate SHA audit and negative/positive handoff.
